hero.headline: स्वाद जो राजस्थान से आया है
hero.intro_copy: From the golden sands of Thar to the royal kitchens of Mewar, we bring you centuries of culinary devotion, prepared on slow woodfire embers and served with genuine royal hospitality.

stages.title: The Whispering Sands of Marwar
stages.body: Under the amber glow of the desert sunset, our journey begins where wild Ker berries and Sangri beans thrive amidst undulating dunes, shaped by ancient winds and untamed warrior spirit.

stages.title: Woodfire Embers & Stone Mills
stages.body: In rural Shekhawati hamlets, the morning rhythm echoes with hand-beaten bajra rotis puffing over clay chulhas, golden cow ghee melting over earthen pots, and hand-pounded Mathania spices filling the crisp air.

stages.title: The Grand Haveli Threshold
stages.body: Carved sandstone arches welcome the weary traveller into fragrant courtyards of marigold and rosewater. Here, royal Khansamas historically crafted feasts fit for kings with recipes guarded as royal state secrets.

stages.title: RAJASTHANI TADKA
stages.body: "From the heart of Rajasthan, served with a modern touch." We invite you to step through our threshold and partake in the royal culinary ritual of Mewar and Marwar.

categories.name: The Royal Thaali
categories.description: A lavish round brass platter embodying the complete spectrum of Rajasthan's gastronomic heritage.

categories.name: Rajasthani Specialities
categories.description: Timeless recipes preserved across royal generations, bursting with indigenous spices and slow-cooked richness.

categories.name: Chulha Breads
categories.description: Hand-flattened artisanal rotis and parathas baked over open clay chulha and wood embers, slathered in fresh white butter.

categories.name: Main Course
categories.description: Rich yogurt-infused curries, slow-simmered gravies, and aromatic curations capturing royal banquet traditions.

categories.name: Royal Desserts
categories.description: Decadent confections steeped in pure desi ghee, saffron threads, pistachios, and thickened clotted cream.

categories.name: Beverages & Chaas
categories.description: Refreshing earthen kulhad drinks, spiced buttermilk, and saffron-cardamom infusions that quench desert thirst.

dishes.name: Grand Maharaja Thaali
dishes.description: The quintessential royal feast served in an antique hand-beaten bronze platter with 14 curated bowls: Dal Baati Churma, Gatte Ki Sabzi, Ker Sangri, Rajasthani Kadhi, Bajra Roti with homemade makhan, Jodhpuri Mirchi Vada, garlic chutney, and saffron malpua.

dishes.name: Mewari Royal Feast
dishes.description: An imperial banquet celebrating Udaipur's warrior kings: featuring slow-simmered spicy Laal Maas, Govind Gatta, Bajre Ka Sogra, Ker Sangri, and Mawa Kachori.

dishes.name: Dal Baati Churma
dishes.description: Flaky golden baatis baked over cowdung cakes and drenched in pure melted cow ghee, paired with aromatic panchmel dal and sweet crushed wheat churma.

dishes.name: Gatte Ki Sabzi
dishes.description: Steamed gram-flour cylinders infused with carom and coriander seeds, simmered in a velvety spiced yogurt gravy with whole red Mathania chillies.

dishes.name: Desert Ker Sangri
dishes.description: Rare wild caper berries (ker) and desert beans (sangri) handpicked from the Thar Desert, stir-fried with raisins, dried mango, and warm rustic spices.

dishes.name: Royal Rajput Laal Maas
dishes.description: The legendary hunting dish of Rajasthan royalty: succulent tender mutton slow-braised for six hours with red Mathania chillies, garlic paste, and smoked charcoal dhungar.

dishes.name: Rajasthani Kadhi Pakora
dishes.description: Tangy buttermilk stew tempered with crackling fenugreek seeds, cloves, curry leaves, and melt-in-mouth onion-besan pakoras.

dishes.name: Dhabha Sev Tamatar
dishes.description: Juicy sweet-sour tomato gravy tempered with cumin, green chilies, and topped with crunchy spiced Ratlami sev.

dishes.name: Bajre Ki Roti with Makhan
dishes.description: Rustic stone-ground pearl millet flatbread, hand-patted and roasted over charcoal embers, served steaming with fresh churned white butter and jaggery.

dishes.name: Tandoori Missi Roti
dishes.description: Crisp whole-wheat and gram flour flatbread kneaded with fresh kasuri methi, chopped onions, pomegranate seeds, and ajwain.

dishes.name: Royal Malai Ghevar
dishes.description: Golden honeycomb pastry immersed in saffron syrup, crowned with velvety slow-reduced malai rabri, silver vark leaf, and crushed Iranian pistachios.

dishes.name: Jodhpuri Mawa Kachori
dishes.description: Crispy puffed golden pastry stuffed with rich sweetened khoya, nuts, and crushed green cardamom, dipped in saffron sugar nectar.

dishes.name: Pushkari Malpua Rabri
dishes.description: Soft melt-in-mouth milk pancakes shallow-fried in desi ghee, dipped in cardamom syrup and ladled with rich creamy rabri.

dishes.name: Kulhad Matka Chaas
dishes.description: Chilled traditional churned buttermilk kept in clay pots, seasoned with roasted cumin, rock salt, mint leaves, and a touch of asafoetida.

dishes.name: Royal Shahi Thandai
dishes.description: Fragrant milk infused with crushed Kashmiri saffron, almonds, melon seeds, rose petals, fennel, and black pepper.

guest_reviews.name: Satrughan Shukla
guest_reviews.title: Service Staff Was Very Coordinative and Customer Friendly
guest_reviews.body: Service staff was very coordinative and customer friendly. Food quality was great and the staff made sure we had a wonderful dining experience. Must visit with family!

guest_reviews.name: Atharv Chaturvedi
guest_reviews.title: The Food Here is Fantastic, Love the Taste!
guest_reviews.body: The food here is Fantastic. Love the taste and the staff was also very cooperative and well behaved👍 Best authentic taste and royal flavours in town.

guest_reviews.name: Anurag Dewan
guest_reviews.title: Delicious, Fresh Food with Clean Ambience
guest_reviews.body: The food was very tasty, delicious and fresh and the ambience was very nice and clean.👍👍👍👍👍 Do visit if you are around Indranagar and Daudpur.

guest_reviews.name: W A
guest_reviews.title: Excellent Service, Great Value ₹200–400
guest_reviews.body: Service was excellent and staff behaviour was also excellent. Atmosphere is pleasant. Great value for authentic food at ₹200–400 per person.

guest_reviews.name: Vaibhav Tripathi
guest_reviews.title: Awesome Food & Authentic Tadka
guest_reviews.body: Awesome food with rich authentic flavours! Staff was very courteous and attentive. A great destination for authentic thalis and desi tadka in Daudpur, Gorakhpur.

guest_reviews.name: Harsh Sadhan
guest_reviews.title: Food Taste is Good & Staff is Humble
guest_reviews.body: Food taste is good and flavours are traditional. Staff is also very humble and welcoming. Highly recommended for family dining in Bansgaon Colony.
